de.abas.ceks.jedp.dialog

Class SimpleDialogInfo

  • Object
    • AbstractDialogInfo
      • SimpleDialogInfo
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    DialogInfo, Serializable

    public class SimpleDialogInfo
extends AbstractDialogInfo
implements Serializable
    Describes a simple server dialog. A server request might require a dialog answer to be processed. Then that dialog is described by an instance of this class, if it is a simple kind of dialog. All dialogs are simple (Dialogbox, selection list, text input) and the answer is just one string.
    Author:
    xg
    See Also:
